data.name: Ectoplasmic Reach
data.description: You can exude small tendrils of ectoplasm that can be used to make melee touch attacks as part of a spell with a range of touch. You can make melee touch attacks as if you had an additional %1 feet of reach. You must have a free hand with which to direct the ectoplasm.&nl;This ability does not otherwise increase your threatened area.|Sorcerer_EctoplasmEctoplasmicReach_Reach
